desc: If you're looking for sheer decadence, try the rich, chocolatey luxury of Betty Crocker Favorites Super Moist Devil's Food Cake Mix. Ready to bake in minutes, this devil's food cake can be topped with delicious cream cheese icing for a classic take or try something new with one of Betty Crocker's many dessert recipes. Bring your family together with the perfect balance of sweet flavor and convenience. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of easy, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes.
features:
• Decadent, rich chocolate flavor — Delivers deep, intensely chocolaty devil’s food cake—ideal for chocolate lovers 
  • Super‑moist, tender crumb — Known for its reliably moist and soft texture that stays fresh
  • Simple & fast prep — Just add water, oil & eggs; go from box to oven in minutes 
  • Perfect for celebrations — Great for holiday gatherings, birthdays, bake-sale treats, or decorating fun 
  • Trusted, quality baking — From Betty Crocker’s long-standing legacy—consistent results every time
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Corn Syrup, Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate). Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Monoglycerides, Salt, Dicalcium Phosphate, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Carob Powder, Artificial Flavor.
